requirements.name: Continuous zoom pan rotate with keyboard alternatives
requirements.gap: B1.8 provides keyboard/pointer interaction on a raster image. F3 already provides a stronger OpenSeadragon deep-zoom source viewer, but it is not integrated into the current workbench route.

requirements.name: Drawing-first visual hierarchy
requirements.gap: Governance/provenance content and forms occupy primary screen area before engineering drawing work.

requirements.name: True technical vector representation from governed document geometry
requirements.gap: Governed vector extraction and an SVG structural scene exist as separate CEW capabilities, but B1.8 does not yet normalize them into one provenance-backed technical projection scene.

requirements.name: Selectable technical objects and hit testing
requirements.gap: F6 ERW contains clickable/selectable SVG structural members and semantic highlighting, but the current B1.8 workbench does not integrate or generalize this scene/object model.

requirements.name: Object-anchored editable recognized text and values
requirements.gap: Proposal is a detached textarea stored in sessionStorage, not an edit bound to a graphical technical object.

requirements.name: Provenance-backed source-to-technical registration transform
requirements.gap: F6 provides semantic evidence↔member synchronization, not a verified continuous SourceCoordinates↔TechnicalCoordinates registration transform.

requirements.name: Synchronized split navigation guarded by valid registration
requirements.gap: F6 already synchronizes source evidence and structural members semantically by governed identity. Spatial pan/zoom synchronization remains blocked until an explicit registration transform exists.

requirements.name: Overlay comparison mode with opacity/alignment controls
requirements.gap: Overlay is anticipated by the ERW contract, but no current B1.8 registered overlay implementation with alignment/opacity controls is verified.

requirements.name: Layer-capable technical scene
requirements.gap: Document/vector and structural SVG capabilities exist separately; a unified typed layer model for source/linework/text/dimensions/candidates/issues/validated objects is not implemented.

requirements.name: Graphically anchored ReadingIssue workflow
requirements.gap: Uncertainty states exist, but they are not anchored to selectable technical geometry.

requirements.name: Progressive disclosure Work -> Evidence -> Provenance
requirements.gap: Internal provenance and governance details are displayed directly in the primary workspace.

requirements.name: Multiresolution or tiled large-drawing rendering architecture
requirements.gap: F3 already implements OpenSeadragon + DZI/libvips deep zoom at 300 dpi. The live B1.8 workbench still embeds a single-raster Evidence Workspace rather than reusing F3.

requirements.name: Dedicated maintainable workbench client/state architecture
requirements.gap: Reusable components exist, but the current user-facing surfaces remain generated HTML/iframes/scripts rather than one typed stateful client suitable for registered multi-viewport interaction.

requirements.name: Desktop-first engineering layout with tablet/narrow review modes
requirements.gap: Responsive/collapsible layouts exist, but there is no explicit device-mode interaction architecture for professional editing versus review.

requirements.name: Saved/reusable professional view state
requirements.gap: No reusable workbench View object stores position, zoom, layer visibility, annotations or selected evidence.

requirements.name: Professional engineering-task HVA protocol
requirements.gap: Current HVA protects authority boundaries but does not yet test the full find-orient-compare-identify-edit-verify-resolve engineering workflow.
